title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager: assess Azure, AWS and Google Cloud through Microsoft Defender for Cloud
summary: Hold: the briefing says the integration's action statuses update automatically rather than through manual testing, but Microsoft requires manual testing for non-technical actions. The roadmap details and most configuration and licensing claims are supported; the control paths and checklist also need small corrections.

claims.quote: Compliance Manager now integrates with Microsoft Defender for Cloud, allowing customers to assess their compliance posture across Microsoft 365, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and Amazon Web Services with resource-level testing and cloud-specific guidance.
